title: Grilled Chicken Sizzler
description: Grilled Chicken Sizzler is a classic Continental main course featuring juicy marinated grilled chicken served on a hot sizzling platter with mashed potatoes or buttered rice, seasonal vegetables, and a rich demi-glace style sauce.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Black pepper – ½ tsp, freshly ground

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Coat the chicken breasts evenly with the marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours or overnight for best flavor.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Blanch the carrots, French beans, and broccoli in salted boiling water for 2–3 minutes.
Drain and toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Keep aside until required.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Sizzler Sauce
steps: Heat butter in a saucepan and sauté the onion and garlic until golden.
Add tomato paste and cook briefly.
Deglaze with red wine if using.
Pour in the brown stock and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer until the sauce thickens to a glossy consistency.
Adjust seasoning and keep warm.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Grill the Chicken
steps: Heat a grill pan or charcoal grill until hot.
Grill the marinated chicken for 5–6 minutes on each side until cooked through (internal temperature 75°C).
Allow the chicken to rest for 3–4 minutes before slicing.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Assemble the Sizzler
steps: Heat a cast iron sizzler plate until smoking hot.
Place a cabbage leaf on the plate.
Arrange mashed potatoes or buttered rice on one side.
Place the grilled chicken in the center and arrange the vegetables around it.
Pour the hot sizzler sauce over the chicken and serve immediately.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately on a hot sizzling platter.
Pair with mashed potatoes or buttered herbed rice.
Enjoy with a fresh green salad or garlic bread.

chefTips: Marinate the chicken overnight for deeper flavor.
Charcoal grilling provides an authentic smoky aroma.
Brush the grilled chicken with butter before serving for extra shine.
Heat the sizzler plate until smoking hot to achieve the signature sizzling effect.
Pour the sauce just before serving to maintain the dramatic presentation.
